objective: Prove that qualification and controlled-mode dry run use one canonical downstream execution-graph construction law under data-dependent eligibility, with complete physical-action accounting and no historical content access.

frozen_execution_law.economic_eligibility_rule: Only validation-selected downstream tasks may enter economic evaluation, preserving the frozen 0067 selection semantics.
frozen_execution_law.p08_eligibility_rule: Only locations with the frozen required eligible base predictions may enter P08 stacking, preserving the frozen 0067 P08 semantics.

canonical_manifest.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, deterministic list ordering, separators comma/colon, newline-terminated

trace_contract.physical_fit_accounting_rule: sum(expected_fit_calls for executable manifest units) must equal observed estimator fit attempts
trace_contract.physical_nnls_accounting_rule: sum(expected_nnls_solves for executable manifest units) must equal observed NNLS attempts

partial_support_acceptance: Downstream economic and P08 counts may contract only through the frozen eligibility law; contracted counts are valid when manifest, trace and physical-action accounting agree exactly.
